CommunityApplications.Profile: UGREEN DXP4800 Pro LED support for Unraid. This repository contains the plugin, matching kernel module, sources, licenses and Community Applications metadata. Support and bug reports: https://github.com/EllipticSet/UGREEN-DXP4800Pro-LEDs/issues. Currently a beta release for Unraid 7.3+ with exact kernel 6.18.38-Unraid.
